span.span: Identify if the book has been published by a major publishing house. Major publishing houses generally undergo an evaluation process before publishing a book. This process involves the book being reviewed by experts in the field and the final decision of the publishing house is influenced by their assessment. A book published by a major publishing house is thus considered a reliable source of information in the field.
Check if the book has been reviewed by major academic journals.

br.span: A book can also be evaluated by experts in the field by submitting it to major academic journals for review. If the book has been published in a major academic journal, it is considered a reliable source of information in the field.

span.span: Identify if the book has been cited by other researchers.

br.span: Another way to evaluate a book is to identify if it has been cited by other researchers in the field. If a book has been cited by other researchers, it is considered a reliable source of information in the field.
